name: Brasilia
description: Brasília is Brazil's capital, built from scratch on the central highlands in the late 1950s and inaugurated in 1960. Planner Lúcio Costa laid it out in the shape of a bird or airplane, with a wide Monumental Axis as its spine. Oscar Niemeyer's gleaming white government buildings, set among Roberto Burle Marx's landscaping, make it a rare, living showcase of modernist design.
